unit_conversion: Input GeV edges multiplied by 1000 exactly once
low_mass_policy: 30 and 35 retained visibly as diagnostics, excluded from primary pooled shapes and laws; 30 nominal core fit invalid
core_definition: Local bin-integrated Gaussian plus nonnegative affine pedestal, fitted with Poisson deviance
resampling: Independent Poisson counts per native bin; repeat mode search and core fit; retain all attempted fits
probability_normalization: All selected counts; underflow and overflow checked zero in all 29 target histograms
empirical_cdf: Piecewise linear CDF on native bin edges, equivalent to uniform within-bin density
common_shape: Equal weight per mass in fitted-center/fitted-width coordinates, tested mass excluded from holdout pool
interpolation: Linear center, log-linear core width, linear mixture of neighboring standardized CDFs; no extrapolation
shape_metric: Maximum absolute CDF difference on target native edges for full shapes; 401-point grid in [-2,2] for conditional cores; descriptive, not a significance test
shift_laws: Equal weight per primary mass; constant, proportional, affine, quadratic, logarithmic; leave-one-mass-out comparison
claim_boundary: Selected-MC response only; no data mass calibration, efficiency, rate, yield-recovery or statistical-inference calibration
